limits.description: Underlying Alkindus aphorisms were not independently collated against the original Arabic/Latin author.
Original printer's errata for printed305,306,307,312,315 have distinct targets and copy-specific ambiguous symbols.
Errata p305 line22 'dele' glyph body-word target not yet securely aligned with original printed line.
Errata p315 line7 replacement glyph is copy-dependent; avoid silent interpretation.
The 1647 copy has handwritten later notes not proved authorial, including margin near Chapter XLIX heading.
Early p305 versus later p317 reverses which party loves more for same first/seventh lord house configuration.
Marriage 'person willing to consent' is inferred symbolically, not actual consent of a person.
House-based mediation and house-based obstacles assign different kinship roles and must remain source-local.
Moon separation and application directions must not be collapsed into a single undirected aspect.
Source sex/gender signifier additions are historic conventions, not validated modern identities.
Source body uses multiple conjunction/aspect/reception alternatives that are not always syntactically clean.
Marriage timing days/months/years depends explicitly on strong testimonies and swift significators.
Source Arabick method counting husbands is not endorsed as the universally best method by Lilly.
Comparisons of spouse nobility and mastery are historical hierarchy, not objective worth.
Ethical warnings to remain silent rather than issue accusations are essential to interpretation.
Reports of sexual conduct or character by planetary configurations are unverified and can cause harm.
Original text distinguishes conduct occurring through force without consent from voluntary conduct.
Original descriptions of young women and unmarried status cannot establish a person's age or life history.
Claims about one spouse dying before the other are untested historic prognoses, not medical information.
Timing of alleged death uses sign-modality order and has no observed timeline or complete ephemeris.
Original p317 'contrary to ancients' is self-reported observational assertion without audited examples.
Source p318 uses eleventh lord for the alleged child's issue; do not silently substitute radical fifth.
Claims about paternity are not evidence of biological fatherhood and cannot substitute genetic testing.
Claims about infidelity or multiple friends do not establish real conduct, identity, or consent.
Source late section on reconciliation uses different chart-role orientations when woman asks herself.
Reunion is portrayed as more or less easy, but neither current consent nor safety follows.
Printed errata list is selective; lack of correction elsewhere is not proof against copy misprints.
The 187 documentary units are editorial segmentation of one source chapter, not independent patients.
Source page images and printed page numbers must not be confused with scan index offsets.
No prospective prediction, modern clinical evidence, relationship cohort or control group exists in this batch.
Anonymous editorial source map and ALTO navigation are subordinate to original rendered images.
Near-identical technical claims can appear in multiple sections and are not independent corroboration.
Historic planet glyphs are copy-dependent; doubtful glyphs must remain unresolved.
The final Chapter L heading on PDF353 is boundary only; its loss-property body is excluded.
